sum: Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. focuses on effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. was formerly known as RTNVM Acquisition Corp. and changed its name to Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. in August 2025. Southern Cross Acquisition I Corp. was incorporated in 2025 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
ceo: Ms. Ally Tong Zhang (Chairwoman of the Board & CEO)
